The Roos, led by first-year head coach [[Marvin Menzies]], played their home games on-campus at [[Swinney Recreation Center]] in [[Kansas City, Missouri]] as a member of [[Summit League|The Summit League (The Summit)]]. The Roos finished the season 11–21 overall, 7–11 in The Summit to finish in a tie for sixth place. As the seventh seed, they were defeated by the [[University of Nebraska Omaha]] in [[2023 Summit League men's basketball tournament|The Summit tournament]] first round. == Previous season == The Kangaroos finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] with a record of 19–12 overall, 12–6 in The Summit to finish in a tie for third place. Head Coach [[Billy Donlon]] stepped down on April 21, 2022 to "pursue other opportunities",{{Cite web|access-date=April 22, 2022|date=April 21, 2022|first=|last=|title=Kansas City Men's Basketball Head Coach Donlon to Pursue Other Opportunities|url=https://kcroos.com/news/2022/4/21/kansas-city-mens-basketball-head-coach-donlon-to-pursue-other-opportunities|website=University of Missouri Kansas City Athletics}} ending his three-year tenure at the helm. Four days later, Donlon was announced as the associate head coach at [[Clemson University]].{{Cite web|access-date=April 26, 2022|date=April 25, 2022|first=|last=|title=Brownell Adds Donlon, Dixon to Coaching Staff|url=https://clemsontigers.com/brownell-adds-donlon-dixon-to-coaching-staff/|website=Clemson University Athletics}} The next day, [[Marvin Menzies]] was hired as head coach for the [[University of Missouri Kansas City]].{{Cite web|access-date=April 27, 2022|date=April 26, 2022|first=|last=|title=Marvin Menzies Tabbed as Roos' Men's Basketball Coach|url=https://kcroos.com/news/2022/4/26/marvin-menzies-tabbed-as-roos-mens-basketball-coach|website=University of Missouri Kansas City Athletics}} Menzies was familiar with the Kansas City program, having coached against them during their days as a member of the [[Western Athletic Conference|Western Athletic Conference (WAC)]] (both as a head coach at [[New Mexico State University]] and an associate head coach at [[Grand Canyon University]]). ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header |high_school = yes |sex = m |team = Kansas City Roos |teamcolors = y |year = 2022 }} {{CBB roster/Player | pos = G | num = 21 | first = RayQuawndis | last = Mitchell | dab = | link = | note = | inj = | cur_rs = | ft = 6 | in = 5 | lbs = 200 | rs = | class = GS | high_school = [[University of Illinois Chicago|UIC]]/
